answers.core: It should be a core addition because I feel like it should be something that a non english speaker wants a dedicated asset library to have names on the languages in order to find their language.
answers.workaround: I don't know how the godot engine works itself so I do not know how it can be changed, but I feel like the drop down menu could store its name and how it should be described as above somewhere.

title: Put language names in the editor settings
